_comment: test-only keys of swept throwaway wallets — never fund
_source: One swap between two throwaway non-HD wallets run on the reference release binary (3.0.0-beta); ARRR is the maker coin, RIN the taker coin. The base key of each node is its RIN WIF (the seed's secp256k1 key).

low_s_cases._comment: Computed from CRD ch.39 R39.5.8 with the taker's base key, NOT observed from the reference. The expected values were computed by an independent pure-Python implementation of the CRD rule, written separately from this Rust code and not part of the repository. The inputs are chosen so that the raw ECDSA s is above n/2, i.e. low-S normalization changes the signature; each case also gives the key a derivation that skipped low-S would produce.
